# Introdução

## Introdução {style="font-size: 0.9em;"}

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="47.5%"}

::: {.box-gold style="font-size: 0.77em;"}
[**O que é o IMDb?**]{.underline}

- Maior base de dados online sobre filmes e séries.
- Usuários registrados atribuem notas de **1 a 10** por título.
- A nota exibida é a **média ponderada** dos votos recebidos.

:::

<br>

::: {.box-gold style="font-size: 0.77em;"}
[**Relevância:**]{.underline}

- A nota IMDb influencia decisões de distribuição e streaming
- Serve como métrica de qualidade percebida pelo público geral
- Amplamente usada em pesquisas de preferência do consumidor

:::

:::

::: {.column width="5%"}
:::

::: {.column width="47.5%"}

::: {.box-gold style="font-size: 0.7em;"}
[**Na Literatura:**]{.underline}

- **Hsu et al. (2014)**:

> "some predictors profoundly affect user rating, such as writers, actors and directors."

- **Miyashiro (2017)**: Modelo inicial probre. Aplicou MMQP na variável oscar.
- **Burns (2018)**: Modelo com 5 preditores teve um R² de 0,2993.
- **Chandra (2019)**: Modelos teve FIVs altos. R² final de 0,365.
- **Cini & Abela (2025)**: 

> "Many factors that influence a movie’s success (such as audience reception or cultural timing) are unpredictable"

- **Rudro et al. (2025)**: XGBoost com R² de 0,3748

:::

:::

# Material

## Os dados

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="45%"}

::: {.box-gold style="font-size: 0.7em;"}
[**Origem dos Dados**]{.underline}

- Fonte original: [Kaggle](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/raedaddala/top-500-600-movies-of-each-year-from-1960-to-2024/data) - *Raed Addala*

- Tratamento Preliminar: [Base Dos Dados](https://basedosdados.org/dataset/6ba4745d-f131-4f8e-9e55-e8416199a6af?table=79de8c5e-9c21-4398-a9fb-bc40e6d6e77f) - *Patrick Teixeira*

:::

<br>

::: {.box-gold style="font-size: 0.8em;"}
[**Composição dos Dados**]{.underline}

- Observações: 33.600 linhas;
- Variáveis: 23 colunas;
  - Numéricas: 11;
  - Categóricas: 12;
- Cobertura: 1960 – 2024.

:::

:::

::: {.column width="5%"}
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}

::: {.box-gold style="font-size: 0.75em;"}

[**Estrutura dos Dados**]{.underline}

| Variável               | Descrição                    | Tipo    |
|------------------------|------------------------------|---------|
| `id`                   | Identificador do filme       | STRING  |
| `title`                | Título                       | STRING  |
| `link`                 | Link IMDb                    | STRING  |
| `year`                 | Ano de lançamento            | INT64   |
| `duration`             | Duração                      | STRING  |
| `rating_mpa`           | Classificação etária (MPA)   | STRING  |
| `rating_imdb`          | Nota IMDb                    | FLOAT64 |
| `vote`                 | Número de votos              | INT64   |
| `budget`               | Orçamento (USD)              | FLOAT64 |
| `gross_world_wide`     | Bilheteria mundial (USD)     | FLOAT64 |
| `gross_us_canada`      | Bilheteria EUA/Canadá (USD)  | FLOAT64 |
| `gross_opening_weekend`| Bilheteria de estreia (USD)  | FLOAT64 |
| `director`             | Diretores                    | STRING  |
| `writer`               | Roteiristas                  | STRING  |
| `star`                 | Estrelas                     | STRING  |
| `genre`                | Gêneros                      | STRING  |
| `country_origin`       | Países de origem             | STRING  |
| `filming_location`     | Locais de filmagem           | STRING  |
| `production_company`   | Produtoras                   | STRING  |
| `language`             | Idiomas                      | STRING  |
| `win`                  | Prêmios ganhos               | INT64   |
| `nomination`           | Indicações                   | INT64   |
| `oscar`                | Indicações ao Oscar          | INT64   |
: {.tabela-tema .tabela-scroll .tabela-tema-destaque1}

:::

## year X rating_imdb

```{r}
#| fig-align: center
#| out-width: "100%"
#| out-height: "80%"
ggplot(df_modelo, aes(x = year, y = rating_imdb)) +
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.12,
    size = 1.3,
    color = "#F5C518"
  )+
  labs(
    x = "Ano de lançamento",
    y = "Nota IMDb"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#141414",color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#141414", color = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#2A2A2A", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "#E8E8F0"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "#E8E8F0", face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(color = "#F5C518",hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

## duration X rating_imdb

```{r}
#| fig-align: center
#| out-width: "100%"
#| out-height: "80%"
df_duration_facet <- df_modelo %>%
  transmute(
    rating_imdb,
    `Duração (minutos)`     = duration_min,
    `log da Duração (minutos)` = log1p(duration_min)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -rating_imdb,
    names_to  = "transformacao",
    values_to = "valor"
  ) %>%
  mutate(transformacao = factor(transformacao, levels = c("Duração (minutos)", "log da Duração (minutos)")))

ggplot(df_duration_facet, aes(x = valor, y = rating_imdb)) +
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.5,
    size = 1.3,
    color = "#F5C518"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ transformacao, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Nota IMDb"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#141414",color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#141414", color = NA),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "#D97706", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#2A2A2A", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "#E8E8F0"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "#E8E8F0", face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(color = "#F5C518",hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16),

```

# Resultados

## O modelo

```{r}
#| fig-align: center
pesos_nomination <- log1p(df_modelo$nomination) + 1

modelo <- lm(
  rating_imdb ~ year + log1p(duration_min) + log1p(vote) +
    log1p(nomination) + 
    rating_mpa + genre + language,
  data = df_modelo,
  weights = pesos_nomination
)
```

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="56%"}

```{r}
#| echo: true
summary(modelo)
```

:::

::: {.column width="4%"}

:::

::: {.column width="40%"}

::: {.box-gold}

- n = 32.850

- weights = `nomination`

- $R^{2}_{ajustado}$ = 0,3946

- $p\text{-valor}_F$ < 2,2e-16

- $\sqrt{QM_{res}}$ = 1,101

-  $QM_{res}$ = 1,21

:::

:::

<br>

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="48%"}

```{r}
#| fig-align: center
#| echo: true
e_pond <- residuals(modelo) * sqrt(pesos_nomination)
h <- lm.influence(modelo)$hat
press_resid_pond <- e_pond / (1 - h)
PRESS_pond <- sum(press_resid_pond^2)
PRESS_pond
```

:::

::: {.column width="4%"}

:::

::: {.column width="48%"}

::: {.box-gold}

- $PRESS$ = 39.876,13

- $R^{2}_{predito}$ = 0,3940

- $R^2$ = 0,3949

:::

## Resíduos Studentizados

```{r}
#| fig-align: center
#| out-width: "100%"
#| out-height: "80%"

h     <- hatvalues(modelo)
rstud <- rstudent(modelo)
cook  <- cooks.distance(modelo)

p <- length(coef(modelo))
n <- nobs(modelo)

limite_leverage <- (2 * p) / n
limite_cook     <- (2 + p) / n

df_diag <- tibble(
  obs   = seq_len(n),
  rstud = rstud,
  h     = h,
  cook  = cook
)

df_diag <- df_diag %>%
  mutate(fitted = fitted(modelo))

count_rstud <- sum(abs(rstud) > 3)   

ggplot(df_diag, aes(x = fitted, y = rstud)) +
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.35,
    size = 1.1,
    color = "#F5C518"
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "#9A9080", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-3, 3), linetype = "dashed", color = "#D97706", linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_smooth(method = "gam", formula = y ~ s(x, bs = "cs"), color = "#D97706", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(
    x = "Valores ajustados",
    y = "Resíduo studentizado",
    caption = paste("Outliers:", count_rstud)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#141414", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#141414", color = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#2A2A2A", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "#E8E8F0"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "#E8E8F0", face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(color = "#F5C518", hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, color = "#E8E8F0"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

## Alavanca & Influência

```{r}
#| fig-align: center
#| out-width: "100%"
#| out-height: "80%"
p <- length(coef(modelo))
n <- nobs(modelo)

limite_cook <- (2 + p) / n
limite_leverage <- 2 * p / n

h_seq <- seq(min(df_diag$h[df_diag$h > 0]), max(df_diag$h) * 1.02, length.out = 200)

curva_cook <- function(cook_level, h_seq, p) {
  sqrt(cook_level * p * (1 - h_seq) / h_seq)
}

df_curvas <- tibble(h = h_seq) %>%
  mutate(
    cook_lim_pos = curva_cook(limite_cook, h, p),
    cook_lim_neg = -curva_cook(limite_cook, h, p)
  ) %>%
  filter(cook_lim_pos < 10)

count_leverage <- sum(h > limite_leverage)
count_cook <- sum(cook > limite_cook) 

ggplot(df_diag, aes(x = h, y = rstud)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      color = cook > limite_cook,
      alpha = cook > limite_cook,
      size  = cook > limite_cook
    )
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "#F5C518", "TRUE" = "#F5C518")) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("FALSE" = 0.35, "TRUE" = 0.35)) +
  scale_size_manual(values = c("FALSE" = 1.1, "TRUE" = 1.1)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "#9A9080", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "#9A9080", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = limite_leverage, linetype = "dashed", color = "#D97706", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_line(data = df_curvas, aes(x = h, y = cook_lim_pos), color = "#D97706", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_line(data = df_curvas, aes(x = h, y = cook_lim_neg), color = "#D97706", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  # Rótulo da linha vertical (limite de leverage)
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = limite_leverage, y = max(df_diag$rstud) * 1.05,
    label = paste0("Limite leverage = ", round(limite_leverage, 5)),
    color = "#D97706", size = 3, hjust = -0.05, vjust = 0
  ) +
  # Rótulo da curva de Cook (parte positiva)
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = max(df_curvas$h) * 0.7,
    y = approx(df_curvas$h, df_curvas$cook_lim_pos, xout = max(df_curvas$h) * 0.7)$y,
    label = paste0("Distância de Cook = ", round(limite_cook, 5)),
    color = "#D97706", size = 3, vjust = -0.8
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = range(df_diag$rstud) * 1.1) +
  labs(
    x = "Leverage (hii)",
    y = "Resíduo studentizado",
    caption = paste(
      "Pontos de alavanca:", count_leverage,
      "|  Pontos de influência:", count_cook)
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#141414",color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#141414", color = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#2A2A2A", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "#E8E8F0"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "#E8E8F0", face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(color = "#F5C518",hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, color = "#E8E8F0"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```
